title: Case #3 — SKAO staged delivery (AA1)
description: SDC1 field, 30 min with SKA-Mid AA1 (8 x 15 m SKA dishes, longest baseline 1.4 km) in Band 2: 1310 MHz centre, 720 MHz in 64 channels of 11.25 MHz, 8 s integrations, phase centre RA 0h, Dec -30 deg. Sky: the SKA Data Challenge 1 560-1400 MHz catalogue (Bonaldi et al. 2021), 80095 sources >= 10 uJy out to 1.55 deg, with their own spectral indices, attenuated by a Gaussian primary beam. Thermal noise from per-antenna SEFDs (304 Jy SKA dishes, eta_c 0.95), no RFI flagging. Natural-weight thermal rms 26.55 uJy/beam. WSClean multiscale image (scales 0-96 px), Briggs robust -2, 8192 x 8192 px over 0.6 deg (0.264 arcsec), 8 output channels joined, 400000 iterations, mgain 0.8, auto-threshold 1, auto-mask 3; plus an OSKAR dirty image.
